breakdown.description: The given relative velocities/angles imply different axial components, contradicting the statement that axial velocity is constant.
breakdown.reason: The agent kept W2=100 m/s and beta2=30° from the original flawed prompt while asserting Cz=106.07 m/s (derived from W1 and beta1). This is still inconsistent because W2*cos(beta2) = 100*cos(30°) ≈ 86.60 m/s ≠ 106.07 m/s. The ground truth resolves this by recalculating W2 = Va/cos(beta2) ≈ 122.5 m/s. The agent failed to make this correction.
